content: We need count of carbonyl groups in the molecule. IR spectrum shows peaks at 1717, 1705 cm-1 typical carbonyl stretch. Two peaks could be one carbonyl (maybe conjugated) or two carbonyls. Need decide. Could also be overlapping. Usually carbonyl stretch appears strong around 1700. Two peaks close could be due to different carbonyls (e.g., ketone and ester) or due to Fermi resonance. Without more info, maybe count distinct carbonyl groups. Could also use carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons (~200 ppm). Could measure carbon NMR. Let's do carbon NMR to see number of carbonyl carbons.
